title: THERE IS NO ONE LIKE GOD

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "There is no one like the God of Jeshurun, who rides across the heavens to help you and on the clouds in his majesty. The eternal God is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He will drive out your enemies before you, saying, 'Destroy them!'" — Deut 33:26-27 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
As Moses draws his blessing toward its close, he lifts the people's eyes back to the greatness of God: "There is no one like the God of Jeshurun." And then comes one of the most beloved verses in all of Scripture: "The eternal God is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms." What comfort lives in these words. The eternal, matchless God is our refuge, our safe place. And beneath us, always, are His everlasting arms — arms that never tire, never weaken, and never let go.

Think about what it means that "underneath are the everlasting arms." No matter how low we sink, no matter how far we fall, we can never fall below the arms of God. When life gives way beneath us, when everything else fails, His arms are still there, holding us up. There is no rock bottom beneath the everlasting arms of God.

This is our security in every trial. We are not held up by our own strength, which fails, but by the eternal arms of God, which never do. When you feel yourself sinking, remember: underneath you, right now, are the everlasting arms.

And these arms have a name and a face for us. They are the arms of the Father who runs to embrace His returning children, and the arms of Christ stretched wide on the cross to gather us in. Jesus holds us so securely that nothing can snatch us from His grip (John 10:28). So rest in the eternal God who is your refuge. However far you fall, His everlasting arms are underneath you, and they will not let you go.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where do I need to rest in the truth that "underneath are the everlasting arms"?
2. How does knowing I can't fall below God's arms comfort me?
3. What "refuge" am I tempted to run to instead of the eternal God?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Eternal God, You are my refuge, and underneath me are Your everlasting arms. When I feel myself sinking, remind me that I can never fall below Your grip. Hold me secure in the arms of Christ, and never let me go. Amen.
